locator: I q.46 a.2 co.: mundum non semper fuisse, sola fide tenetur, et demonstrative probari non potest
interpretation: That the world began is held by faith alone and cannot be demonstrated, neither from the world (what a thing is abstracts from here and now) nor from the agent cause, which acts by will. Read as the reason why an infinite past cannot be excluded by demonstration, so that a proof of God's existence must work on the eternal-world hypothesis too. It supports STMT-PAST-IS-INFINITE only as a hypothesis.
